# Local STEP reader dependency

Unmodified npm package `occt-import-js@0.0.23`, https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt-import-js/v/0.0.23 . Integrity is recorded in manifest.json. Wrapper source, CMake files and build scripts are supplied here. JavaScript/WASM files load as separate replaceable resources; the workbench is not compiled into them.

Upstream source and OpenCascade submodule: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js . Consult .gitmodules, CMakeLists.txt and upstream README.md for the OpenCascade source and Emscripten build steps. Exact npm gitHead: `c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2`, source https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2 . The pinned occt submodule is `d2abb6d844231cb8f29be6894440874a4700e4a5`; corresponding OpenCascade source: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/tree/d2abb6d844231cb8f29be6894440874a4700e4a5 . OpenCascade source: https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT . Follow the upstream source revision associated with that gitHead when rebuilding.

Licenses: LICENSE.md, dist/license.occt-import-js.txt and dist/license.occt.txt. No vendor source modification was made. Local integration and mesh analysis are in injection-cad*.js. LGPL notices and linked OpenCascade additional exception remain intact.
